visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man with long, wavy dark hair wearing a denim shirt and a red apron. He is excitedly lifting the lid of a large, transparent plastic box containing a massive glass bowl filled with layered strawberry dessert. The background is a bright indoor living room with a gray sofa and a minimalist floor lamp. (2) He holds up a smartphone to the camera, displaying an image of the same dessert, while yellow text overlays appear on the left. He points at the screen with his finger, his facial expression animated. (3) The camera zooms in on the dessert, which is a giant glass fishbowl filled with fresh strawberry slices, blueberries, cream, and sponge cake layers. A small white circular tag with a red logo sits on top. (4) The man uses a spoon to scoop a large portion of the cake from the bowl and places it onto a pink plate. He is smiling and laughing, clearly impressed by the size and appearance of the dessert. (5) A series of close-up shots show the internal structure of the cake—layers of whipped cream, sponge cake, and strawberry filling. The man then takes a large bite, closing his eyes in enjoyment and nodding. (6) In the final phase, he holds the entire heavy bowl with both hands, looking directly into the camera while talking and laughing, with a text overlay prompting the audience to guess the price.
